title: See the salad and vegetable processing line in action at the Lakeland Customer Innovation Center
summary: JBT Marel has installed a full salad and vegetable processing line at its Lakeland Customer Innovation Center, giving fresh cut processors a place to see cutting, washing, dewatering, and drying working together as one continuous process. The line is now available for customer demonstrations and product trials, including salad wash line and wash and dry line applications.
body_markdown:
##### Manufacturing closer to North American customers


The salad and vegetable processing line is also part of a broader shift in how JBT Marel supports fresh cut and frozen fruit and vegetable processors in North America. Selected equipment and components are moving into the manufacturing scope of the Lakeland facility, bringing more of the process closer to the customers and teams that will use, demonstrate, and support it.


This shift is helping build a stronger North American operating model that combines regional manufacturing with hands-on demonstrations, application expertise, service, parts planning, training, and long-term lifecycle support. The Lakeland demo line puts that model into practice by giving customers a place to evaluate the process, work directly with specialists, and plan beyond an individual equipment purchase.


##### Built for hands-on evaluation


The Lakeland Customer Innovation Center gives customers a place to test, validate, and better understand technologies before making decisions for their own operations. The renovated facility includes spaces for live equipment demonstrations, product testing, training, and collaboration with JBT Marel specialists.


The salad and vegetable processing line joins other demo capabilities in Lakeland, including the recently added Flip & Wash bin washer, giving fruit and vegetable processors more ways to evaluate fresh cut processing equipment in a real food processing environment.


At JBT Marel, innovation moves forward through collaboration. By continuing to expand what customers can see and run in Lakeland, we are helping processors ask sharper questions, compare options with real product, and plan their next line with more confidence.


##### Schedule a salad and vegetable processing line demonstration


The salad and vegetable processing line is now available for customer demonstrations and product trials at JBT Marel's Lakeland Customer Innovation Center. To schedule a visit, connect with your JBT Marel representative or fill out the form below, and one of our specialists will get in touch.


You can also meet our team at IFPA and PACK EXPO to learn more about our fresh cut processing solutions and discuss your operation with a JBT Marel specialist.
